body:
This is the index for our Sephiria wiki. Each topic lives on its own page, and every page is checked against the Steam listing, patch notes and cross-sourced community guides. Where a number depends on a patch, that page keeps its version label instead of pretending the number is permanent.

Sephiria at a glance

  • Six chapters and six weapon branches. The store listing also counts 60+ distinct enemies and 10+ bosses.
  • Deep weapon trees — the listing advertises more than 50 unique upgrades per weapon.
  • Artifacts and Tablets are the inventory puzzle: arrange Artifacts, then amplify them with Tablets, so adjacency matters as much as rarity.
  • Online co-op for up to four players, with item trading and revives.
  • Costumes change opening stats, not just looks, so they are part of a build.

Systems and progression

  • Destiny Inscription tree — the permanent sapphire tree.
  • Artifacts and Tablets — grid rules, adjacency, Side Bag behaviour.
  • Wishing Fountain — the town Artifact picker.
  • Root’s Retreat — the Hard Mode stage run.
  • Scythe (Drifa) — why the scythe is a Dagger route, not a seventh weapon.

Builds and combat

  • Builds overview — archetypes, Artifact and Tablet pairings, version notes.
  • Companion / summoner setup — the classic pet build.
  • Weapons and weapon upgrades — branch comparison and evolution routes.

Characters, costumes and NPCs

  • Characters — the playable hero, what costumes do, and the tower NPCs.
  • Costume roster and unlocks — every skin with its effect and unlock condition.

Bosses and enemies

  • Bosses: Erma (Mad Scientist) and the final boss (Qliphoth)

Co-op

  • Multiplayer setup — requirements, host steps, invites.
  • Co-op play guide — party scaling, trading, revives, co-op-friendly builds.

How this wiki is kept honest

Official statements come from the Steam listing and the team’s patch notes; everything else is labelled as community consensus or a single-source report. Version labels stay visible, so you can tell how old a number is. If a page disagrees with your client, trust your client and tell us through contact.

Every page on the site is also listed in the guide index.
